messages:
jess: quick question — for the compliance audit next week, does anyone know the easiest way to pull a 'who changed permissions' delta for the last 90 days? needs to include before/after ACLs, actor, timestamp, and request_id. prefer JSONL or parquet.
samir: we have two paths: admin console export (UI) and the audit API. API is better for structured fields. example query:
```
GET /v1/audit/logs?filter=action:permission_update&start=2025-12-01&end=2026-03-01&format=jsonl
```
response items include actor, actor_email (redacted for PII unless you have access), action, target_type, target_id, before, after, request_id, ts
marta: note: hosted accounts default retention is 90 days unless customer is on enterprise retention (365+). Dedicated/Private customers can request longer via contract. also we mask IPs and user emails in exports unless the requester is in sec-approvals + the contract allows it.
jess: perfect — is there a standard schema name/field list I should send to audit for the compliance team? they asked for column order and types.
dave: we keep a canonical schema in the audit-service docs. quick list (CSV/JSONL):
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- request_id
- actor (display_name)
- actor_id
- actor_email (redacted or hashed)
- action
- target_type
- target_id
- before (json string)
- after (json string)
- service
- region
- admin_role (if applicable)
- auth_method
marta: also include `redaction_level` in the export metadata — values: none, pii_hashed, pii_removed. for Private customers with KMS enabled, exports are encrypted with customer KMS key; include kms_key_id in metadata.
jess: how do I get the export started? would prefer programmatic so I can automagically upload to the S3 bucket for the auditors.
samir: use the exports API:
```
POST /v1/audit/exports
payload: {
  "start":"2025-12-01",
  "end":"2026-03-01",
  "filter":"action:permission_update",
  "format":"jsonl",
  "redaction":"pii_hashed",
  "delivery":{"type":"s3","bucket":"redwood-audit-uploads","prefix":"jess/2026-03"}
}
```
Requires an approver from `sec-approvals` for PII-including exports.
infra-bot: export job started: job_id=exp_202603101200_42, eta ~ 18m. :rocket:
jess: thanks — pinging sec-approvals for the approval now. @sec-approvals can you approve PII-hashed export for auditors? justification: compliance request, SOC2 prep. timeframe 2025-12-01 -> 2026-03-01.
sec-approvals: Approved. Please make sure the request includes the justification doc link and the S3 bucket is owner-encrypted. note: we escalate if export includes `before` with raw emails.
samir: once export is done, you get a signed S3 URL; objects named `audit_export_exp_202603101200_42_part-000.jsonl.gz` (gzipped). metadata file `exp_202603101200_42.meta.json` accompanies it with schema and `redaction_level`.
jess: perfect — will wait for the URL and then handoff to auditors. thanks all :thumbsup:
